# AI Desktop Studio

> **Multimodal desktop creation studio** for generative models (Electron 43 + React 19 +
> TypeScript). Six workshops — Image, Video, 3D, Audio, Materials, Skyboxes — in one window
> with dockable panels, a timecoded timeline, an inspector and a project library on disk.
> Offline dictation, and **310 MCP actions across 26 families** so an agent drives the studio
> through the same paths the interface uses.

## Mental model (read this first)

- **A project is a folder.** Documents, imported assets and generations stay on disk, in
  formats other software already reads — OpenRaster, OpenTimelineIO, glTF, MaterialX. The
  application browses it and git versions it, without leaving the window.
- **No generation form is written by hand.** A model's parameters are its own and change
  without warning, so `ModelRegistry` reads the schema at runtime and turns it into fields.
  An unknown type falls back to raw input rather than making the form disappear.
- **Engines are rebuilt from their state.** Detaching a panel destroys its graphics context;
  the engine reconstructs itself identically — which is also where undo and saving come from.
- **The interface never sees the API key.** Key and secret are encrypted by the system store.
  The window asks "am I signed in?", never "what is my key?".
- **The application gives access to no generation service.** It uses the API key you provide,
  under your own account and at your expense.

## Where things are

- `src/main/` — Electron main process: windows, secrets, filesystem, git, MCP server.
- `src/renderer/` — React 19 interface: the six workshops, panels, inspector, timeline.
- `src/shared/` — what crosses the boundary: constants, contracts, types.
- `engine/` — the Python side, driven by uv (speech recognition and local tooling).
- `docs/en/`, `docs/fr/` — the manual and the architecture, in both languages.
- `docs/ci/adr/` — seventeen decisions, each with what was ruled out and why.
- `site/` — the presentation site: one template, fifteen dictionaries, a shared build.

## Running it

```
pnpm install
pnpm start          # electron-vite in watch mode
pnpm validate       # the gate: llms, licences, typecheck, lint, format, tests
pnpm build:site     # the presentation site, fifteen languages, into _site/
```
